strategies.name: Detecting Bulk or Anomalous Access to Private Code Repositories via SaaS Platforms

analytics.name: Analytic 0732
analytics.guidance: Anomalous or bulk download activity from private or restricted repositories by non-developer or privileged accounts, often preceded by unusual login behavior (e.g., unfamiliar geo, OAuth token use, elevated API rate).

tuning.description: Threshold for file access volume over short duration (e.g., 10+ repos accessed in <5 min)
Role or permission profile expected to interact with repositories (e.g., developers vs. admins)
Distance or variance allowed before a login is flagged as anomalous
Whether a repository is labeled sensitive or restricted
